fullName.value: Clathrin-interacting protein localized in the trans-Golgi region

texts.value: Binds to membranes enriched in phosphatidylinositol 4,5-bisphosphate (PtdIns(4,5)P2). May have a role in transport via clathrin-coated vesicles from the trans-Golgi network to endosomes. Stimulates clathrin assembly

Binds clathrin heavy chain and AP-2 (PubMed:12213833, PubMed:12429846, PubMed:12538641). Interacts with VTI1B (PubMed:18033301). Interacts with GGA2 (via GAE domain) (PubMed:12213833, PubMed:14665628). Interacts with AP1G1 (via GAE domain) (PubMed:12213833, PubMed:12429846, PubMed:12538641, PubMed:14665628). Interacts with AP1G2 (via GAE domain) (PubMed:14665628)
Found throughout the cell, with the exception of the cell surface. Concentrated in the perinuclear region and associated with clathrin-coated vesicles close to the trans-Golgi network
Ubiquitously expressed at low to intermediate levels
Genetic variations in CLINT1 may contribute to susceptibility to schizophrenia (SCZD1) and psychotic disorders in some populations

features.description: Interaction with AP1G1, AP1G2 and GGA2
Reduces lipid binding. Abolishes lipid binding; when associated with G-34.
Abolishes lipid binding; when associated with L-29.
Abolished binding to VTI1B. Rescued binding to VTI1BR-23 mutant.
